description:
As a new visitor, I want to create an account so I can place orders.

* All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
* An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
* Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
* A customer under 18 years old cannot register.
** Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
** Password must be at least 8 characters.
** Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old."

criteria.text: All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it. (Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.)
An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors. (Password must be at least 8 characters.)
A customer under 18 years old cannot register. (Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old.")

cases.title: Register with all required fields valid, then sign in
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available, together with <a password of at least 8 characters> and <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older>.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> in the first name field.
Enter <a last name> in the last name field.
Enter <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older> in the date of birth field.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters> in the password field.
Submit the registration form.
Open the sign-in page.
Sign in with the email and password just used to register.
cases.expected: The account is created (the exact confirmation wording is not specified in the story) and the sign-in with the registered email and password succeeds.

cases.title: Registration blocked when a required field is left empty
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered>, <a password of at least 8 characters> and <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older> are available.
steps: Open the registration page.

Fill in first name, last name, date of birth, email and password with valid data, but leave one required field empty - repeat the test once for each required field: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
Submit the registration form.
Open the sign-in page and try to sign in with the email used in step 2.
cases.expected: The account is not created, because the story only promises account creation when all required fields are filled with valid data; the sign-in attempt does not succeed. The exact message or validation wording shown for the empty field is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Registration with an already-registered email
cases.preconditions: <an email address that already has a registered account> exists in the system. The registration page is reachable.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> and <a last name>.
Enter <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older>.
Enter <an email address that already has a registered account> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Submit the registration form.
Check the list of accounts for that email address (admin/back-office customer list or equivalent).
cases.expected: A clear error about the email already being registered is shown (the exact wording is not specified in the story) and no duplicate account is created - only the one pre-existing account for that email remains.

cases.title: Inline validation error for invalid email format
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> and <a last name>.
Enter <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older>.
Enter <a value that is not a valid email format, e.g. missing @ or missing domain> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the email field and the account is not created. The exact error text is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Inline validation error for password below 8 characters
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> and <a last name>.
Enter <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older>.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter a password of 7 characters in the password field.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the password field because the password is below the minimum length of 8 characters, and the account is not created. The exact error text is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Password of exactly 8 characters is accepted
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> and <a last name>.
Enter <a date of birth that makes the customer 18 or older>.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter a password of exactly 8 characters in the password field.
Submit the registration form.
Open the sign-in page and sign in with the email and the 8-character password.
cases.expected: No password length validation error is shown; the account is created and the sign-in succeeds, because 8 characters meets the minimum length.

cases.title: Customer under 18 cannot register
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> and <a last name>.
Enter a date of birth that makes the customer clearly under 18 (for example a date 15 years before today's date).
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Submit the registration form.
Open the sign-in page and try to sign in with the email used in step 4.
cases.expected: Registration is rejected with the message "You must be at least 18 years old.", no account is created, and the sign-in attempt does not succeed.

cases.title: Customer whose 18th birthday is today can register
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available. Today's date is known so the date of birth exactly 18 years before today can be calculated.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> and <a last name>.
Enter the date of birth that falls exactly 18 years before today's date.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Submit the registration form.
Open the sign-in page and sign in with the email and password just used.
cases.expected: No age error is shown (the customer is 18, not under 18); the account is created and the sign-in succeeds.

cases.title: Customer one day before their 18th birthday cannot register
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available. Today's date is known so the date of birth can be calculated.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <a first name> and <a last name>.
Enter the date of birth that falls 18 years before tomorrow's date, so the customer turns 18 tomorrow.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered> in the email field.
Enter <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Submit the registration form.
Open the sign-in page and try to sign in with the email used in step 4.
cases.expected: Registration is rejected with the message "You must be at least 18 years old.", no account is created, and the sign-in attempt does not succeed.
